ja260:1.1: Yass' atthā dūram āyanti amittam api yācituṃ tass' ūdarass' ahaṃ dūto, mā me kujjhi rathesabha.
ja260:2.1: Yassa divā ca ratto ca vasam āyanti māṇavā tass' ūdarass' ahaṃ dūto, mā me kujjhi rathesabhā 'ti.
ja260:3.1: Dadāmi te brāhmaṇa rohiṇīnaṃ gavaṃ sahassaṃ saha puṅgavena, dūto hi dūtassa kathaṃ na dajjā, mayam pi tass' eva bhavāma dūtā ti.
